jobs.title: Kustos/Kustodin (w/m/d) in der Mathematisch-Naturwissenschaftlichen Fakultät, Botanischer Garten
jobs.reason: Requires a completed university degree in Biology plus a completed (or at minimum submitted) doctorate and an established research profile in botany/systematics — qualifications the candidate does not hold. The field (curatorial leadership of a botanical garden) is entirely outside the candidate's competence and interests.

jobs.title: Spezialist*in Security Incident Management im ISMS
jobs.reason: This is a deep-technical information-security incident-management role requiring an IT/information-security degree, several years' experience in a security incident response team, ISO/IEC 27001 or BSI IT-Grundschutz certifications and hands-on IT-security expertise — essentials the candidate plainly lacks. It also requires multi-year experience (Manager/Spezialist level) and IT credentials, well outside the candidate's profile and interests.

jobs.title: Rechtswissenschaftliche*r Mitarbeiter*in der Berichterstattungsstelle Menschenhandel
jobs.reason: The post explicitly requires a Volljurist*in (fully qualified German lawyer with both state exams) plus several years of research or legal practice in migration and labour law — an essential legal qualification and experience level the candidate does not hold. The human-rights and monitoring subject is a perfect interest match, but the qualification requirement is a hard disqualifier.

jobs.title: Studentische Hilfskraft (m/w/d) für das Team Lesungen & Veranstaltungen
jobs.reason: This is a studentische Hilfskraft / Werkstudium role, which is excluded by policy as a student side-role rather than a genuine paid professional position. It also requires current enrolment at a German university and is administrative event support outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Volontariat (w/m/d) im Referat 45 Bücher
jobs.reason: A Volontariat is a structured post-graduate traineeship / apprenticeship-type qualification programme (explicitly a 24-month "Ausbildungsjahr" with trainee tariff pay), which falls under the excluded apprenticeship/traineeship category rather than a genuine paid professional role. The editorial/book-publishing focus is also outside the candidate's core interest zones, and it emphasises editorial experience the candidate largely lacks.

jobs.title: Produktionsassistent*innen für die Hauptabteilung Programmressourcen
jobs.reason: The role requires a completed media-production training (Volontariat/Aufnahmeleiter*in) with many years of professional experience, plus technical production, business/controlling and rights knowledge the candidate does not have — an unmet essential and clearly not entry-level for this profile. It is also entirely outside the candidate's research/policy interest zones.

jobs.title: Sales Manager B2B (m/f/d) – Europe.Table (Standort Brüssel)
jobs.reason: Ineligible on two counts — the "Manager" role explicitly requires several years of B2B sales / business-development experience (Mehrjährige Erfahrung), well beyond the candidate's student-assistant background, and it is a sales/networking function that does not match the candidate's research profile. Although the European-policy media context is mildly adjacent, this is a commercial sales role the candidate cannot credibly hold.

jobs.title: Research Associate (Postdoc) Natural Language Processing § 28 Subsection 2 HmbHG
jobs.reason: The profile requires an already-completed doctorate plus a publication track record in NLP/computational linguistics — an unmet essential qualification, as this is a postdoc, not a PhD candidate post. It also demands deep NLP/AI method implementation well beyond analysis-level Python.

jobs.title: Research Associate for the Project "Drought Vulnerability of Mycorrhizal Functions in the Forest Floor"
jobs.reason: The essential profile requires a university degree in Biology, Geosciences, or Environmental Sciences, which the candidate — an IR / politics graduate — does not hold. Although it is a funded PhD position (otherwise eligible), the hard-science field requirement is an unmet essential and the topic is entirely outside the candidate's areas.

jobs.title: Shared Service Accountant (m/f/d) - Maternity Cover (4 months)
jobs.reason: Ineligible: this is an accounting role requiring an accounting/finance degree and 3-5 years of hands-on shared-service-centre accounting experience — an essential the candidate does not meet. Although ECFR is a core-interest think tank, this is a finance function unrelated to research, and the experience requirement is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (PostDoc) (d/m/w)
jobs.reason: Requires an already-completed PhD (Promotion) in physics, which the candidate does not hold, so it is a hard disqualifier. It is also a deeply technical semiconductor-nanophotonics postdoc entirely outside the candidate's field and skills.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (d/m/w) - 75 % Arbeitszeit (Astrobiology / Mars habitability)
jobs.reason: Requires a completed Master's in Biology, Physics, Chemistry or Geology plus experience in planetary habitability and laboratory/field work under Mars-simulated conditions — essentials the candidate's IR/social-science background cannot meet. The subject is entirely outside all three interest zones.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (d/m/w) - 75 % Arbeitszeit
jobs.reason: Requires a completed Master's in Physics or a related field plus expertise in semiconductor physics, nanophotonics and quantum optics — all essential qualifications the candidate plainly lacks. This is a physics doctoral post in quantum photonics, entirely outside the candidate's IR / international law profile and interest zones.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (d/m/w) - 75 % Arbeitszeit
jobs.reason: This is a physics doctoral position requiring a completed Master's in physics with essential expertise in solid-state and semiconductor physics, quantum optics and experimental nanophotonics — none of which the candidate has. It is a fundamental field mismatch far outside the candidate's IR / law background.

jobs.title: Praktikant*in im „Fonds Förderung Internationale Agrarforschung" (FIA) mit Fokus auf Kommunikation und Netzwerke
jobs.reason: This is an internship (Praktikum), which is excluded as a matter of policy, and it further requires current student enrolment or graduation within the last 6 months. The topic (agricultural research, food security) also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Praktikant*in im (Digital-) Projektmanagement
jobs.reason: This is explicitly an internship (Praktikum) requiring current enrolment or a degree completed no more than 6 months prior — an internship is excluded as a matter of policy. The digital project-management focus is also only tangential to the candidate's core interests.

jobs.title: Rechtsreferendar*innen (w/m/d/k)
jobs.reason: This is a Rechtsreferendariat station requiring the candidate to be a German legal trainee (after the first state law exam), a legal qualification the candidate does not hold. It is also a mandatory-station placement within German legal training rather than a general paid role, and the subject matter (contract, copyright, procurement law) is outside the candidate's field.

jobs.title: Analyst (m/f/d) Carbon Markets and Climate Policy
jobs.reason: The role accepts an IR/political-science degree and the "at least two years relevant experience" is a soft ask that RA work only partly meets, keeping it eligible with a real soft obstacle; strong analytical and writing skills transfer well. However, carbon-market/climate-policy economics sits outside the candidate's core interest zones and requires topic-specific specialisation they lack, which holds the priority down.

jobs.title: Administrator*in Microsoft 365 für den Bereich Kommunikationssysteme
jobs.reason: This is a deep-technical IT-administration role requiring a completed computer-science degree or IT vocational training plus multiple years of hands-on Microsoft 365 / Entra ID / PowerShell administration in production environments — essentials the candidate's analysis-level Python and non-technical background cannot meet. It is also outside all interest zones and firmly not entry-level.
